fields.CritBase: Damage multiplier of a critical hit before any bonus.
fields.CritGladiatorBonus: Critical damage added for each Gladiator level above the opponent's.
fields.CritEnchantmentBonus: Critical damage added when a weapon has the critical hit enchantment.
fields.HealthMultiplier: Health per Constitution point and level. Also scales the Battlemage fireball against this class.
fields.WeaponMultiplier: Scales the minimum weapon damage that comes from the level. Used when the equipped weapon is weaker.
fields.DamageMultiplier: Multiplies all damage this class deals.
fields.MaximumDamageReduction: Highest damage reduction armor can give, in %.
fields.MaximumDamageReductionMultiplier: Multiplies the damage reduction from armor, after the cap.
fields.SkipChance: Chance to skip (commonly block or evade) an attack.
fields.SkipLimit: Most skips in a row. The count resets when an attack hits.
fields.SkipVariant: How a skipped attack is shown in fight logs.
fields.UseBlockChance: Uses the block chance set on the player instead of the skip chance.
fields.BypassSkipChance: Attacks can't be blocked or evaded.
fields.BypassSpecial: Turns off the opponent's class abilities, such as revives, summons and the fireball.
fields.ReviveChanceDecay: Revive chance lost after each revive.
fields.ReviveHealth: Health after the first revive, in % of max health.
fields.ReviveHealthMin: Lowest health after a revive, in % of max health.
fields.ReviveHealthDecay: Revive health lost after each revive, in % of max health.
fields.ReviveDamage: Damage dealt before any revive, in % of normal damage.
fields.ReviveDamageMin: Lowest damage dealt after revives, in % of normal damage.
fields.ReviveDamageDecay: Damage lost after each revive, in % of normal damage.
fields.SwoopChance: Chance of a swoop at the start of the fight. A swoop is an extra attack before the normal one.
fields.SwoopChanceDecay: Swoop chance lost after each swoop. A negative value raises it.
fields.SwoopBonus: Added to the damage multiplier for a swoop.
fields.CriticalSwoopBug: Copies a game bug: a critical swoop adds the critical and swoop bonuses together instead of multiplying them.
fields.EffectRounds: Turns between songs. The first song plays on the first turn.
fields.EffectBaseDuration: Attacks a song lasts, for song levels 1 to 3.
fields.EffectBaseChance: How often each song level is picked, as weights for levels 1 to 3.
fields.EffectValues: Damage bonus of a song, for song levels 1 to 3.
fields.CriticalSongBug: Copies a game bug: a critical hit during a song adds the critical and song bonuses together instead of multiplying them.
fields.SummonChance: Chance to summon a minion when none is out.
fields.SummonImmediateAttack: The minion attacks on the turn it is summoned.
fields.StanceInitial: Stance at the start of the fight.
fields.TinctureChance: Chance to throw a tincture instead of a normal attack, when none is active.
fields.TinctureReviveBug: Copies a game bug: when the tincture poison kills an opponent who revives or uses Seal of Death, the normal attack after it keeps the tincture's damage.
fields.DaggerChance: Chance of a dagger attack after a normal attack, until Seal of Death is used.
fields.DaggerSacrifice: Current health lost on each dagger attack, in %.
fields.PactStacksMax: Most Blood Pact stacks. Each dagger attack adds one.
fields.SealHealth: Health after Seal of Death revives, in % of max health.
fields.SealHealthPerStack: Revive health added for each Blood Pact stack, in % of max health.
fields.ScytheChance: Chance of a scythe attack instead of a normal attack after Seal of Death.

groups.Rage: State the Druid enters for its next turn after evading an attack.
groups.Summons: Minions the Necromancer can summon. One is picked at random.
groups.Stances: Paladin stances. The Paladin switches through them in order.
groups.TinctureThrow: State used for the tincture throw. The Plague Doctor stays in it after a blocked throw until the next throw.
groups.TinctureRounds: Plague Doctor states while a tincture is active, by turns left. A landed throw starts at 3 turns left.
groups.Dagger: State used for the dagger attack.
groups.Scythe: State used for the scythe attack.
groups.Revived: State after Seal of Death revives the Blood Weaver.

opponents.description: Changes the damage dealt to each class. The bonus is added to the damage multiplier, then the result is multiplied by the multiplier.

state_fields.DamageBonus: Added to the damage multiplier in this state.
state_fields.SkipChance: Chance to block or evade an attack in this state.
state_fields.SkipVariant: How a skipped attack is shown in fight logs in this state.
state_fields.CriticalBonus: Critical damage added in this state.
state_fields.CriticalChance: Highest critical chance in this state.
state_fields.CriticalChanceBonus: Added to the critical chance from Luck in this state, before the cap.
state_fields.ReviveCount: Times the minion can come back.
state_fields.ReviveDuration: Turns the minion stays after coming back.
state_fields.ReviveChance: Chance the minion comes back when its time runs out.
state_fields.DamageReductionBonus: Damage reduction added to armor in this state, in %, before the cap.
state_fields.MaximumDamageReductionBonus: Added to the highest damage reduction from armor in this state, in %.
state_fields.StanceChangeChance: Chance to switch to the next stance at the start of each turn.
state_fields.HealMultiplier: Damage of a blocked attack healed instead, in %.
